name: MindPad
tagline: A gesture-controlled AI learning canvas that builds flashcards and diagrams as you ask questions.

awards: Best Overall Hack [Courtesy of Amplitude, Anthropic, OpenAI]
Best Practical AI Innovation by Amazon
Best Use of Gemini API by MLH

problem: Students juggle slides, notes, videos and AI tabs; passive screen learning fails many, including neurodiverse or physically limited learners.
solution: A canvas controlled by hand gestures tracked from the webcam, with agents that generate flashcards, diagrams and explanations from questions.
demo_moment: Team-described: gesture to create a diagram and turn it into flashcards.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Overall Hack [Courtesy of Amplitude, Anthropic, OpenAI]” and “Best Practical AI Innovation by Amazon” and “Best Use of Gemini API by MLH” among 195 submissions.
Frames learning around asking good questions.
Won Best Overall plus two AI prizes.

lessons: Gesture input makes an AI study tool feel new in the room.
